name: Story Time
description: Teaches through a story for young learners: a question to wonder about, the story in short steps, new words, what the characters did, and a drawing or acting activity.
audience: Classes 1–5: moral stories, EVS concepts told as stories, language lessons.

signals.why: your words ask for a story
young learners learn well through stories

slides.guidance: A friendly title for the story of {topic}, with a subtitle naming the class.
A question that makes a young child wonder about {topic}.
The story of {topic} in 4 to 6 short steps, each one simple sentence.
3 or 4 new words from the story with very simple meanings.
What the story teaches, in 2 or 3 short points a child can repeat.
One question: what would you do if you were in the story?
Draw, act or retell the story: short instructions, minutes, pairs or groups.
Three things we learned from the story.
